name: Tailscale
description: Joins the device to your tailnet as its own node (WireGuard, DERP and DISCO) so Termz can reach it from anywhere without a subnet router. Works with Tailscale or Headscale.

status.notes: Needs PSRAM: the upstream component (Csontikka/esphome-tailscale, built on microlink) says a classic ESP32 without PSRAM is not expected to work. No routeOS image with this module has been built yet and it has not been run on hardware.
